note: Source-derived handler semantics. Some opcodes rewrite lane entries in place; serialized lane tuples are not assumed to equal finalized/runtime tuples.

opcodes.1: pc = R[H] (then common pc increment applies)
opcodes.6: call R[H] as function using register/table range described by S,w; move packed returns back into register frame
opcodes.8: table.move from register range S+1..S+w into table R[H] starting at H+1
opcodes.11: copy 3 consecutive register pairs S[i] -> w[i]; consume 3 slots
opcodes.13: copy S registers from varargs into R starting at H
opcodes.15: pc = w (then common pc increment applies)
opcodes.20: conditional jump: if R[H] <= w then pc=S else fall through
opcodes.23: self-rewrite/decode current S,w,H,opcode lanes; pc-- to re-execute rewritten slot
opcodes.30: instantiate/dispatch nested object from aux_I with capture descriptors in aux_v; store result in R[H]
opcodes.38: self-rewrite/decode current lanes from serialized backing buffer; rewrites to opcode 12
opcodes.39: copy 4 consecutive register pairs S[i] -> w[i]; consume 4 slots
opcodes.47: self-rewrite/decode current S,w,H,opcode lanes; pc-- for rewritten re-execution
opcodes.48: switch VM mode: mode=w; pc=S+1; break to outer mode dispatcher
opcodes.49: expand/copy H following lane tuples using bit-selected source slot; rewrite current opcode to 12
opcodes.52: vararg load/pack: N=w,p=S; copy first N-1 varargs to R[p..], then R[p+N-1]=table.pack(select(N,...))
opcodes.54: pack register range H..w into table with .n and store in R[S]
opcodes.60: call R[w] with register range and copy fixed number of packed returns into R
opcodes.62+ except 63: self-rewrite/decode current lanes; pc-- for rewritten re-execution
